metadata.question: Between June 15-21, 2017, did temperatures in Phoenix, Arizona reach at least 110 degrees fahrenheit?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use ERA5-Land hourly 2m air temperature (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY) over Phoenix, AZ (TIGER/2018/Places) between 2017-06-15 and 2017-06-22. If zero images (unlikely), fallback to ERA5 daily maximum air temperature (ECMWF/ERA5/DAILY).
2. Masking: Not needed for reanalysis data (no clouds).
3. Validity: Check collection size, pixel count within geometry, and ensure max temperature is within a realistic Kelvin range (180–350 K). If invalid, output C1/C2/C3 accordingly.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); # You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = '2017-06-15';
    const end = '2017-06-22'; // exclusive
    const places = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/Places')
      .filter(ee.Filter.and(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Phoenix'), ee.Filter.eq('STATEFP', '04')));
    const placeCount = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => places.size().evaluate(resolve, reject));
    let geom, geomSource;
    if (placeCount && placeCount > 0) {
      geom = places.geometry();
      geomSource = `TIGER polygon (features: ${placeCount})`;
    } else {
      geom = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.0740, 33.4484]).buffer(25000);
      geomSource = 'Point buffer (25 km)';
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check (primary: ERA5-Land Hourly)
    let dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY';
    let band = 'temperature_2m';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .select(band);
    const imgCount = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => col.size().evaluate(resolve, reject));

    if (!imgCount || imgCount === 0) {
      // Fallback to ERA5 Daily maximum 2m air temperature
      dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5/DAILY';
      band = 'maximum_2m_air_temperature';
      col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select(band);
    }

    const finalCount = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => col.size().evaluate(resolve, reject));
    if (!finalCount || finalCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Geometry: ${geomSource}`);
      console.log(`${dataset} Images: 0`);
      console.log('No data in date/location.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing: max over time, then reduce over space; count pixels
    const maxOverTime = col.max().clip(geom); // pixelwise max across the period
    const countDict = await new Promise((resolve, reject) =>
      maxOverTime.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 9000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).evaluate(resolve, reject)
    );
    const pixCount = countDict ? countDict[band] : 0;
    if (!pixCount || pixCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Geometry: ${geomSource}`);
      console.log(`${dataset} Images: ${finalCount}`);
      console.log('Valid pixels after processing: 0');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const maxDict = await new Promise((resolve, reject) =>
      maxOverTime.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.max(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 9000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).evaluate(resolve, reject)
    );
    const maxK = maxDict ? maxDict[band] : null;
    if (maxK === null || maxK === undefined || isNaN(maxK) || maxK < 180 || maxK > 350) {
      console.log(`Geometry: ${geomSource}`);
      console.log(`${dataset} Images: ${finalCount}`);
      console.log(`Valid pixels (count): ${pixCount}`);
      console.log(`Max value invalid: ${maxK}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const maxF = (maxK - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32;
    const reached = maxF >= 110;

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`Geometry: ${geomSource}`);
    console.log(`${dataset} Images: ${finalCount}`);
    console.log(`Valid pixels (count): ${pixCount}`);
    console.log(`Max 2m air temp: ${maxF.toFixed(1)} F`);
    console.log('Threshold: 110 F');
    console.log(reached ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
